model: the_blockage_button=0, the_blockage_button_antes=0, the_pressure_mode=0, the_pressure_mode_antes=0, the_reset_button=1, the_reset_button_antes=0

text: When the pressure mode becomes high, the Safety Injection System shall assign false to the overridden mode.
guard: the_pressure_mode_antes != high /\ the_pressure_mode = high
model: the_blockage_button=0, the_blockage_button_antes=0, the_pressure_mode=2, the_pressure_mode_antes=0, the_reset_button=0, the_reset_button_antes=0

text: When the pressure mode becomes not high, the Safety Injection System shall assign false to the overridden mode.
guard: the_pressure_mode_antes = high /\ the_pressure_mode != high
model: the_blockage_button=0, the_blockage_button_antes=0, the_pressure_mode=0, the_pressure_mode_antes=2, the_reset_button=0, the_reset_button_antes=0

text: When the pressure mode is low, and the overridden mode is true, the Safety Injection System shall assign off to the safety injection mode.
guard: the_pressure_mode = low /\ the_overridden_mode = true
model: the_blockage_button=0, the_blockage_button_antes=0, the_overridden_mode=True, the_pressure_mode=0, the_pressure_mode_antes=0, the_reset_button=0, the_reset_button_antes=0

text: When the pressure mode is low, and the overridden mode is false, the Safety Injection System shall assign on to the safety injection mode.
guard: the_pressure_mode = low /\ the_overridden_mode = false
model: the_blockage_button=0, the_blockage_button_antes=0, the_overridden_mode=False, the_pressure_mode=0, the_pressure_mode_antes=0, the_reset_button=0, the_reset_button_antes=0

text: When the pressure mode is permitted or the pressure mode is high, the Safety Injection System shall assign off to the safety injection mode.
guard: the_pressure_mode = permitted \/ the_pressure_mode = high
model: the_blockage_button=0, the_blockage_button_antes=0, the_pressure_mode=1, the_pressure_mode_antes=0, the_reset_button=0, the_reset_button_antes=0

text: (alarme_ativo and porta_aberta) or botao_emergencia
guard: (alarme_ativo and porta_aberta) or botao_emergencia
model: alarme_ativo=True, botao_emergencia=False, porta_aberta=True

text: porta_fechada and not obstaculo
guard: porta_fechada and not obstaculo
model: obstaculo=False, porta_fechada=True

text: freio_acionado or (freio_acionado and pedal_pressionado)
guard: freio_acionado or (freio_acionado and pedal_pressionado)
model: freio_acionado=True, pedal_pressionado=True
